changes.title: AWS Glue adds 100 new native connectors for popular SaaS applications
changes.detail: AWS Glue now supports 100 new native connectors that simplify access to data in popular SaaS and REST API-based applications. Previously, bringing data from SaaS applications into AWS required writing custom code. Now, teams can create a connection once in the AWS Glue Data Catalog and reuse it across ETL jobs with the same permissions model they already use for AWS Glue. The new connectors span generative AI, finance, payments, marketing, product analytics, human resources, engineering, IT operations, and collaboration tools. changes.title: AWS Sign-In now supports OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
changes.detail: AWS Sign-In now supports OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693), enabling applications to exchange third-party OpenID Connect (OIDC) tokens for short-lived, AWS service-scoped OAuth access tokens. This allows customers to securely integrate third-party applications with supported AWS services without sharing AWS credentials, while maintaining access controls through AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
